common_target.continuous_domain: observed interior cells for fitting and sampled interior cells for generation
common_target.conditional_mean: reuse the exact G0-A outer-fold train-only NWP ridge contract
common_target.level_normalization: u=r/s_r where s_r=sqrt(mean_outer_train_active(r^2)); no held-out statistic and no mean recentering
common_target.decode: r=s_r*u; x=mu_hat_outer_fold+r; active power=sigmoid(x); exact sampled zero and one atoms are then reconstructed
common_target.missing_target_cells: excluded from fitting and scoring and never treated as physical zeros
common_target.joint_scope: all ten zones and all 24 hours are generated jointly

mask_conditioned_transform.active_sampling_mask: sampled_interior_state from the shared train-only atom law
mask_conditioned_transform.segment_definition: maximal physically contiguous active-hour run within each zone and member
mask_conditioned_transform.true_transition_operator: within every segment, retain its first residual as an anchor and store first differences for all later physical hours
mask_conditioned_transform.inverse: segmentwise cumulative sum from the generated anchor
mask_conditioned_transform.coefficient_layout: same [zone,hour] slots as the source nodes; inactive slots are exactly zero
mask_conditioned_transform.train_only_scale: multiply each non-identity operator by one positive outer-train scalar so its active coefficient RMS equals the level-coordinate RMS
mask_conditioned_transform.wrong_adjacency_order: within each segment use the frozen outside-in order [0,L-1,1,L-2,...], retaining exactly one anchor and the same active dimension
mask_conditioned_transform.short_segment_rule: length-one segments are anchors; length-two segments are non-informative for the wrong-adjacency mechanism audit but remain invertible
mask_conditioned_transform.orthogonal_control: orthonormal DCT-II independently within each active segment with its exact inverse

shared_atom_contract.fit_scope: one NWP-only E/A nuisance model per outer fold on outer-train targets only
shared_atom_contract.architecture: reuse the architecture-v1 condition encoder and exact three-state atom head topology from family-v1

shared_atom_contract.sharing: the same frozen probabilities, allocation seed, sampled states, and active masks are used for every path and both denoiser seeds within an outer fold

shared_atom_contract.purpose: prevent target-state leakage while keeping the Probe focused on the continuous representation
